description: AskAgent: the ask-the-clinic agent's structured model outputs (M2-09): the intent verdict, the tool plan and the cited answer. Research prototype; synthetic data only.

IntentVerdict.description: The model's half of the medical-question classifier (the lexicon is the other). A failure counts as medical: refuse and flag (safety rule 2).

ToolPlan.description: Which tools answer a clinic question. The tools take no arguments from the model: the session comes from the verified token and the query is the patient's question.

ClinicAnswer.description: A short answer in the session language, citing the handbook sections (or `live:queue`) it rests on. The agent checks every cited id against what was retrieved.
